_note: Shapes read off backend/server.py's execute_modify branches, recorded in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-29-wave-6-storage-keys-reference.md. Wave 6 corrected the entity vocabulary rather than working around it, so these keys now match what the tool contract advertises: `fluency` (not the old phantom `proficiency`), `purpose` (not `label`), and education's `degree_level`/`field_of_study`/`start_year`/`end_year`/`status` (not `degree`/`field`/`period`). `education.coursework`, `clubs` and `highlights` are BARE STRING arrays -- which is why profile has no second level of child list. This key itself is inert: no ui node addresses it. Every string value here is deliberately UNIQUE across the whole section: describeGuards proves a field is bound by locating its stored value with getByDisplayValue, which throws on more than one match. `organisation` and education's `institution` both read "Northumbria University" at first and made the guard ambiguous for reasons that had nothing to do with the binding under test.
